name: Shuggah Lickurs
description: Shuggah Lickurs play a DJ set and party at Maus Hábitos in Porto.
longDescription:
Shuggah Lickurs perform a DJ set at Maus Hábitos on 21 November 2026.

The party takes place at Rua de Passos Manuel, 178, 4th floor. The event starts at 23:59 and entry is 8€.
